host.framework: JUCE JUCE v8.0.6 AudioPluginFormatManager / VST3PluginFormat, VST3 SDK bundled with JUCE
host.note: standalone console app, not a DAW; plugin instantiated headlessly
host.display_string_source: AudioProcessorParameter::getText(normalised, 256) -> IEditController::getParamStringByValue. Strings are byte-for-byte as returned. getText with maximumLength 0 returns "" in JUCE 8, so 256 is used.

capture.defaults_state: snapshotted from the instance as created by createPluginInstance(44100, 512), before prepareToPlay and before any sweep
capture.prepare_probe_note: the read-only taper was taken twice, once as created and once after prepareToPlay(44100, 512), to catch plugins that only format once prepared
capture.write_sweep_note: a write sweep is used only for parameters whose read-only sweep returned the same string at every t, which means the plugin ignores getParamStringByValue's value argument. Each write sweep restores the parameter's original value.
capture.cross_parameter_state_note: parameters are not independent (on Supermassive, DelayNote's display depends on DelaySync). Every write sweep is preceded by restoring ALL parameters to their snapshot values, so one parameter's sweep cannot leak into the next one's strings. Per parameter, restored_cleanly records whether the display came back.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.label_note: AudioProcessorParameter::getLabel() -> VST3 ParameterInfo::units. null means the plugin left that field empty; the unit is then only visible inside the display strings.
parameters.value_domain: JUCE normalises every VST3 parameter to 0..1; min and max below are that normalised domain, not the plugin's real-world range. The real-world range is only observable through the display strings.
parameters.num_steps_note: JUCE derives this from VST3 ParameterInfo::stepCount: stepCount 0 means 'continuous' and JUCE substitutes its default step count. A parameter that displays as an enum but reports the default step count is one the plugin declared continuous.
parameters.value_items_from_getAllValueStrings_note: JUCE 8's VST3Parameter::getAllValueStrings() returns {} unconditionally. A null here is a JUCE limitation, not a statement about the plugin. The measured string_plateaus below are the real item source.
parameters.taper_method: write sweep: setParamNormalized(id, t) then getParamStringByValue, original value restored
parameters.read_only_sweep_constant_note: getParamStringByValue returned the same string for every t, i.e. the plugin ignores the value argument and formats its current value. See taper_read_only for the evidence.
parameters.restored_cleanly_note: true means that after the sweep, with every parameter set back to its snapshot value, this parameter formatted exactly as it did on the untouched instance. False means the plugin latched state the sweep could not undo, and this parameter's taper may be contaminated.

string_plateaus.method: t = k/1000 for k in 0..1000, write sweep, consecutive equal strings collapsed
string_plateaus.runs_omitted_reason: more than 64 distinct runs, i.e. continuous rather than stepped; the 21-point taper is the sample

parameters.value_items_from_getAllValueStrings_note: JUCE 8's VST3Parameter::getAllValueStrings() returns {} unconditionally. A null here is a JUCE limitation, not a statement about the plugin. The measured string_plateaus below are the real item source.
parameters.value_items_source: measured: distinct runs of the 1001-point display-string sweep, in order
parameters.taper_method: write sweep: setParamNormalized(id, t) then getParamStringByValue, original value restored
parameters.read_only_sweep_constant_note: getParamStringByValue returned the same string for every t, i.e. the plugin ignores the value argument and formats its current value. See taper_read_only for the evidence.
parameters.restored_cleanly_note: true means that after the sweep, with every parameter set back to its snapshot value, this parameter formatted exactly as it did on the untouched instance. False means the plugin latched state the sweep could not undo, and this parameter's taper may be contaminated.

string_plateaus.method: t = k/1000 for k in 0..1000, write sweep, consecutive equal strings collapsed
